name: Lifting Hero
summary:
Welcome to Lifting Hero, the ultimate VR adventure where strength means everything—no matter what you’re lifting! Start small with pencils and grow by training with quirky items like sneakers, speakers, surfboards, and even basketballs. Every rep makes your character bigger, stronger, and funnier!
